name: village-store-coins-and-meeple-v1
description: ⭐ BOTH NEW SUBSYSTEMS TOGETHER, AND IT IS THE ONLY ARM THAT CAN ANSWER C111. The assembled Village Store coin (rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard 1, coinSupplyPerPlayer 5, coinPaysBuild, coinPaysSuitCost, coinPaysGrow and coinGrowOnFullBuilding all true) plus the delivery meeple as ruled (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false). Ruled by Dean 12/09/2026, ledger A150 and A151, docs/village-store-coins-2026-09-12-v2.md sections 2 and 5. ⛔ IT HAS THREE CONTROLS AND ALL THREE READINGS ARE WANTED. Against overlays/village-store-coins-v1.overlay.json it is the meeple's marginal effect ON TOP OF the coin; against overlays/delivery-meeple-v1.overlay.json it is the coin's marginal effect on top of the meeple; and against overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-by-seats-v1.overlay.json, whose twenty leaves are all pinned here by name, it is the whole package. ⛔ THE INTERACTION IS THE POINT, AND IT IS THE ONE THING THE THREE SINGLE ARMS CANNOT SHOW. If the two-rule reading is not the sum of the two one-rule readings, that difference is C111 and it is the finding. ⛔ C111, AND IT IS THE RISK THAT EXISTS ONLY BECAUSE THE TWO ARRIVED TOGETHER. ISLAND RECEIPTS ARE ALREADY 64% OF A WINNING SCORE AGAINST A DESIGN TARGET OF 50%-PLUS, AND BOTH NEW RULES PAY YOU FOR DELIVERING. The coin's only mint hangs off a delivery, and a vegetable meeple buys a Deliver, which mints coins, which buy builds and Grows, which fill barns, which feed deliveries. DOES DELIVERY BECOME THE ANSWER TO EVERYTHING? Read the island's share of a winning score, deliveries per player, game length against 23 / 20 / 18 rounds, and the vegetable share of the meeple colour mix, all four together. If the island share climbs and the vegetable meeple is over-represented in what gets spent, the chain is real and the design has one action with three payoffs. ⛔ C100 IS STILL OPEN AND NO NOTICE BOARD ARM IS RULED IN AS THE SHIPPED GAME: the shipped default is rules.turn.visitCurrency 'commons', so THIS IS AN ARM ON TOP OF AN ARM. It is also the third new subsystem in one week, on top of the seat-shaped host draw ruled the same week, and C116 records the teach-weight question that no run can answer. Every report header quoting this file must say both things. ⭐ EVERY BUILDER DEFAULT BEARS ON THIS ARM, WHICH IS TRUE OF NO OTHER FILE IN THE FAMILY, and they are named here because on 05/09/2026 an arm built for one purpose carried three unnamed knob changes and ruling it in ruled all four. Dean confirmed the indicated reading on all of D1 to D9 on 12/09/2026 and ruled D7 explicitly. D1: cards paid into the exchange go to the SUIT'S DISCARD and never out of the game, which is Dean's circulation argument and the Store's best case. D2: ANY delivery mints, including one bought by a Notice Board power OR BY A VEGETABLE MEEPLE, not only a main-action Deliver. D3: declining to mint is EXPLICIT, so the turn settles cleanly. D4: an empty supply mid-conversion STOPS rather than refusing the whole exchange. D5: a coin-Grow DOES fire 'when activated' abilities, which is the whole point of a Grow and is stated because V8 places no card. D6: a coin does NOT count as a card for any card text that counts cards paid, the same family as the O17 fix. D7 ⭐ RULED BY DEAN: the meeple spend is legal on ANY turn once the action window has closed, whether the main action was taken or passed. D8: the meeple's plain action IS subject to the standing rule that an illegal action is not offered, so a meeple can be UNDISCARDABLE. D9: ⛔ THE MEEPLE'S DELIVER DOES MINT COINS, which is D2 from the other side and is the exact seam C111 is about. IF ANY OF D2 OR D9 IS LATER RULED THE OTHER WAY, THIS ARM'S READING IS VOID RATHER THAN MERELY DATED. ⛔ WHAT MAY NOT BE QUOTED OFF THIS ARM. (1) THE BONUS RATE IS A SHARE OF TURNS AND NEVER PLAYS PER TURN. Judging the band on plays cost this project a re-run of five arms on 09/09/2026, and the bonus slot at four seats has one tenth of a point of headroom under the control. (2) NO LEVEL HERE IS COMPARABLE WITH A reference-v14 OR EARLIER NUMBER; only a delta paired on identical seeds against one of the three named controls is sound. (3) THE BARN GLUT READS +0.5 IDENTICALLY ACROSS THIS WHOLE FAMILY ON BYTE-IDENTICAL PER-SEAT LINES, so read the per-seat rows and NEVER the pooled median: four arms already disagree only in the pooled figure, which is an argument about the metric and not about the design. AND THE BARN GLUT IS THE NUMBER THE COIN IS AIMED AT, so this caveat is load-bearing here rather than boilerplate. (4) The hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S bound (C7) and the table plays with none, so nothing here is evidence about hand tightness in either direction. (5) ⛔ A BAD READING OFF THIS FILE NAMES NO CULPRIT. That is the whole reason the four coin arms and the two meeple arms exist, and the 05/09/2026 lesson is that an arm ruled in is a bundle ruled in. Do not take this arm to Dean without the singles beside it. ⛔ C113, THE COIN HALF'S OWN TEST, WHICH APPLIES HERE UNCHANGED. docs/village-store-2026-08-19-v1.md section 1 tested this exact rider-on-Deliver placement and ruled it out: 'Free / a rider on Deliver. No cost, so it is always correct. Breaks everything.' Dean's answer of 12/09/2026 is that a valid delivery is a precondition and the capped, shared, contested supply bounds the reward. THE CORE OBJECTION STANDS AS A TEST: if the arm shows every player converting every spare card every time, the August verdict was right and THE PLACEMENT IS WHAT TO CHANGE. ⚠️ AND IT IS SHARPEST IN THIS FILE, because a meeple that buys a Deliver buys a mint with it. ⚠️ ACTIONS PER TURN IS THE OTHER FIRST NUMBER, passing at only 1.61 against a target of 1.5, with every meeple spent adding an action and every coin-Grow changing what an action costs rather than how many there are. ⛔ EVERY PASSENGER IS PINNED BY NAME. THIRTY LEAVES. The control's twenty, unchanged and in its own order: rules.turn.visitCurrency, bonusTiming, selfVisitAllowed, hostDrawOnVisit, commonsTake, startingMeeplesPerColour, meepleAsCard, slotToll, meepleCapPerColour; rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold, noticeBoardBlocks, unclaimedBoardsToCentre, noticeBoardsBySeats.2, .3 and .4, commonsColourMatch, commonsWildPair, endgameCoinCost, farmsteadCoinPower; and rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisitBySeats.4. ⛔ TWO OF THOSE ARE COIN LEAVES AND THEY STAY OFF ON PURPOSE: rules.economy.endgameCoinCost null and rules.economy.farmsteadCoinPower false belong to the separate commons-with-coins arm of 10/09/2026 and are a second mint and a second sink; keeping them off is what makes rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard the only faucet, and every coin economy this project has had died of a second faucet or a pity rate. ⛔ AND rules.turn.startingMeeplesPerColour STAYS 0 AND rules.turn.meepleAsCard STAYS false: the meeples here come from the island and nowhere else, which is the whole difference between this and the economy a table rejected on 09/09/2026. Then all six coin leaves on, and all four meeple leaves at the rule as ruled. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired against all three controls on identical seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. ⚠️ AS OF COMMIT e5aea08 ALL TEN NEW LEAVES ARE INERT: they exist in the data layer and no branch of play reads them yet, so this arm currently measures identically to its controls. A run before the engine slices land proves the file parses and validates, and nothing else. ⛔ PINNED AT dairyGrowsBuilt 'none' ON 12/09/2026, WHEN THE BASE MOVED TO 'paidWild'. Every number published off this arm was measured BEFORE Dean ruled the Dairy board's follow-on Grow in, so the pin is what keeps this file reproducing what it measured. A new arm that wants the ruled rule should say so by name. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved.
